name: win32-toolkit
description: win32-toolkit delivers end-to-end Intune Win32 packaging: point at a winget package or any installer, scaffold a PSAppDeployToolkit v4 project, and capture real installs in a disposable Windows Sandbox or Hyper-V VM. It derives detection and uninstall logic, validates install/update paths, packages a .intunewin, and publishes to Intune with dependencies, branding, and requirements.
author: Maxime Guillemin

securityCheck.aiSummary: The codebase does not perform remote downloads or credential theft and contains no data exfiltration patterns. Two security concerns exist: (1) ExecutionPolicy.Bypass usage in the launcher, which can enable code execution outside policy controls, and (2) dot-sourcing of organization hook scripts from templates, posing a risk if assets/templates are compromised. Mitigations include signing/enforcing execution policies, asset integrity checks, and avoiding dynamic dot-sourcing of untrusted scripts.
